purpose: Where The Reefer's listings come from: one entry per public source, state by state and country by country. Read by pipeline/ (see pipeline/README.md). Hand-maintained.

baseline_per_state.store_list: Regulator licensee list or open-data export (this file, topic retail / medical-dispensary)
baseline_per_state.law: data/state-permissions.json answers with citations and review dates
baseline_per_state.medicaid_and_coverage: data/medical-coverage.json (national answer, state program pages as sources)
baseline_per_state.lawmakers_and_advocacy: Ohio (data/legislators.json) and Pennsylvania (pennsylvania-advocacy.html) only so far

baseline_per_country.where_to_buy: data/world-where-to-buy.json via import_where_to_buy.py (regulator lists; manual download)

sources.publisher: Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services, Division of Cannabis Regulation
sources.title: Verified dispensary map layer (licensed dispensary facilities)
sources.kept_rule: Every row: the layer lists only dispensaries the Division has verified as operating.
sources.label: dispensaries the Division of Cannabis Regulation lists as verified

sources.publisher: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation, Cannabis Regulation Oversight Office
sources.title: Dispensary locations (State of Illinois public data, dispensary map export)
sources.kept_rule: Every row: the map lists licensed adult-use dispensaries; the Serves Medical Patients column marks those that also serve registered patients.
sources.label: dispensaries the State of Illinois lists
sources.limitations: The State's map export has no ZIP, phone, website or license number. A dated copy, not a live license verification.

sources.publisher: Minnesota Office of Cannabis Management
sources.title: Public data on cannabis and lower-potency hemp edible license holders
sources.kept_rule: License types that can sell to consumers at a storefront (retailer, microbusiness, mezzobusiness, medical combination); hemp-only types are left out.
sources.label: license holders the Office of Cannabis Management lists
sources.queue_note: Column names not yet confirmed; the first run prints them.

sources.publisher: Michigan Cannabis Regulatory Agency
